headlines.title: 美银：若美联储说不清如何抗通胀方案美国国债就会重拾跌势
headlines.summary: 美国银行全球研究部的美国利率策略主管Mark Cabana认为，如果美联储不能更好地告诉大众它将如何实现2%的通胀目标，美国国债的跌势就会重新出现。 上周三将收益率推至近20年高位的长债抛售是一次“教科书式的通胀公信力冲击”。当天，美联储主席凯文·沃什在记者会上未能向投资者解释央行将如何抑制价格上涨。 “你有坚定的决心实现2%的通胀是很好，但除非你告诉我们你要怎么做到，否则我们是不会相信你的，” Cabana接受彭博电视采访时说，“而且你也骗不了债券，它会看穿你。”

headlines.title_en: BofA: US Treasuries to Resume Decline If Fed Fails to Clarify Inflation-Fighting Plan
headlines.summary_en: Mark Cabana, head of US rates strategy at BofA Global Research, believes that if the Federal Reserve cannot better communicate to the public how it will achieve its 2% inflation target, the selloff in US Treasuries could re-emerge. The long-end selloff that pushed yields to nearly 20-year highs last Wednesday was a "textbook inflation credibility shock." That day, Fed Chair Kevin Warsh failed to explain to investors at a press conference how the central bank would curb price increases. "It's great that you have firm determination to achieve 2% inflation, but unless you tell us how you're going to do it, we won't believe you," Cabana said in a Bloomberg TV interview. "And you can't fool the bond market—it will see right through you."

headlines.title_en: CSRC: Focus on Synergy in Five Areas to Deepen Mainland-Hong Kong Market Cooperation
headlines.summary_en: [CSRC: Focus on Five Areas of Coordination to Deepen Mainland-Hong Kong Market Cooperation] On August 3, CSRC Chairman Wu Qing delivered remarks at the launch ceremony for RMB government bond futures in Hong Kong. Wu noted that the CSRC will focus on coordination across five areas—functions, products, ecosystem, regulation, and governance—and further roll out policy measures to deepen two-way practical cooperation and support the development of Hong Kong's capital market. It will, as always, support domestic enterprises expanding internationally in listing in Hong Kong, support high-quality Hong Kong-listed companies in listing domestically, and jointly maintain the steady operation of both markets.

headlines.title_en: US Treasury Raises July-September Borrowing Estimate to $739 Billion
headlines.summary_en: The US Treasury projects net marketable debt issuance of $739 billion in the July-September 2026 quarter, assuming a cash balance of $950 billion at end-September. The estimate is $68 billion higher than the May figure, mainly due to expected lower net cash inflows. The Treasury projects $628 billion in financing for the October-December 2026 quarter, assuming an $850 billion cash balance at end-December. For the April-June 2026 quarter, the Treasury financed $190 billion, broadly in line with the $189 billion estimate published in May. Further details on the quarterly refunding will be released at 8:30 a.m. ET on August 5 (8:30 p.m. Beijing time).

headlines.title_en: Innovation and Going Global Drive Profitability Gains for A-Share Biopharma Companies
headlines.summary_en: In the first half of 2026, A-share biopharmaceutical companies saw significantly improved overall profitability, delivering strong results amid resilient development, with innovation-driven growth and domestic and overseas market expansion serving as core drivers of earnings gains. As of August 3, 104 A-share biopharmaceutical companies disclosed first-half results (including interim reports and earnings forecasts). Based on the lower bound of forecast net profit growth, 67 companies expect profit increases (including turning losses around or narrowing losses). In addition, 10 companies, including WuXi AppTec, Wohua Pharmaceutical, and Zai Lab, published interim reports, of which 7 reported year-on-year net profit growth or a turnaround to profit. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 美国中长期国债收益率跌超4个基点
headlines.summary: 周一（8月3日）纽约尾盘，美国10年期国债收益率跌4.90个基点，报4.6857%，整体窄幅震荡于4.68%附近、北京时间20:02刷新日低至4.6674%。 两年期美债收益率涨3.72个基点，报4.2518%；30年期美债收益率跌4.19个基点，报5.2295%，整体持续低位窄幅震荡。 2/10年期美债收益率利差跌0.373个基点，报+43.185个基点。 10年期通胀保值国债（TIPS）收益率跌2.05个基点，至2.4265%；两年期TIPS收益率涨1.02个基点，至2.0968%；30年期TIPS收益率跌3.19个基点，至3.0031%。

headlines.title_en: US Medium- and Long-Term Treasury Yields Fall Over 4 Basis Points
headlines.summary_en: Monday (August 3) New York close: the US 10-year Treasury yield fell 4.90 basis points to 4.6857%, trading in a narrow range around 4.68%, hitting a session low of 4.6674% at 8:02 p.m. Beijing time. The 2-year Treasury yield rose 3.72 basis points to 4.2518%; the 30-year yield fell 4.19 basis points to 5.2295%, hovering at low levels in a narrow range. The 2s10s spread fell 0.373 basis point to +43.185 basis points. The 10-year TIPS yield fell 2.05 basis points to 2.4265%; the 2-year TIPS yield rose 1.02 basis points to 2.0968%; the 30-year TIPS yield fell 3.19 basis points to 3.0031%.

headlines.title: 广发证券：牛市中 什么时候才会出现“单顶”
headlines.summary: 【证监会：聚焦五方面协同 深化内地和香港市场合作】8月3日，中国证监会主席吴清在香港推出人民币国债期货上市仪式上致辞。吴清指出，中国证监会将聚焦功能、产品、生态、监管、治理等五方面协同，进一步推出深化双向务实合作、支持香港资本市场发展的政策举措，一如既往地支持拓展国际布局的境内企业赴港上市，支持优质港股上市公司境内上市，共同维护两地市场稳健运行。

headlines.title: 道明：干预势头可能短暂推动美元/日元跌至153
headlines.summary: 道明证券认为，干预的推动力可能会使美元/日元跌至153，但除非日本央行采取更多行动或美国财政部做出全面承诺，否则就只会暂时如此。“动能可能短暂推动美元/日元跌至153，但要没有日本央行的行动或美国财政部的全面承诺，我们不认为该货币对会大幅低于该水平，” Howard Du、Gennadiy Goldberg和Molly Brooks等策略师写道。“美日双边贸易动态、‘卖出美国’情绪复苏的风险、美国信誉恶化的风险、政治考量以及包括系统性冲击在内的风险，是我们相信美国财政部不愿全力托底日元的五大原因”。

headlines.title_en: TD: Intervention Momentum May Briefly Push USD/JPY to 153
headlines.summary_en: TD Securities believes intervention momentum could push USD/JPY to 153, but without more action from the Bank of Japan or a fuller commitment from the US Treasury, it would only be temporary. "Momentum could briefly push USD/JPY to 153, but without BOJ action or a fuller Treasury commitment, we don't see the pair moving significantly below that level," strategists including Howard Du, Gennadiy Goldberg, and Molly Brooks wrote. "US-Japan bilateral trade dynamics, the risk of a 'Sell America' sentiment revival, the risk of deteriorating US credibility, political considerations, and risks including systemic shocks are the five reasons we believe the US Treasury is reluctant to fully underpin the yen."
